errors.evidence: The chart does not have a right y-axis. All data is plotted against the single y-axis on the left.
The orange line represents the year-on-year percentage growth, not the share of internet buyers. The values are 7.8%, 7.3%, etc., which are growth rates.
The value 7.8% is shown for the year 2018, representing the growth from 2017 to 2018. There is no percentage value for the year 2017.
The orange line, representing growth rate, does not continuously grow. It decreases from 7.8% (2018) to 4.4% (2021) before it starts to grow again.
The orange line is a solid line without any visible markers.
The description incorrectly lists the percentage for 2021 as 8.4%. According to the chart, the value for 2021 is 4.4%.

The mapping of percentage values to years is consistently off by one year. The percentages represent year-on-year growth and correspond to the end year of the period (e.g., 7.8% is for 2018, not 2017; 7.3% is for 2019, not 2018, etc.).
